data.name: Finding Fairies
data.detailed_description:
Finding Fairies is a cosy co-op fantasy investigation game where you and your friends use magical tools, teamwork, and deduction to discover which fairy is hiding nearby.

For generations, fairies lived quietly alongside humans, hidden deep within forests, gardens, ruins, and forgotten magical places. Most people believed they were only stories, glimpses of glowing lights in the trees or strange sounds carried on the wind.

But recently, fairy activity has begun to rise.

Magical traces are appearing across the land. Glowing petals have been found where no flowers grow. Strange footprints vanish moments after being discovered. Fairy dust reacts with unknown energy, enchanted orbs drift through the air, and mysterious sounds echo from places that should be silent.

To understand what is happening, a small group of fairy investigators has been formed.

That is where you come in.

Enter enchanted locations, search for evidence, and use your collection of magical investigation tools to identify the fairy before returning through the portal. Each fairy leaves behind a different combination of clues, so careful observation and teamwork are the key to solving each mystery.

Investigate Magical Activity

Explore beautiful fantasy environments and look for signs of nearby fairy activity. Evidence may be hidden in the world, appear only through certain tools, or reveal itself when the fairy interacts with the area.

Work Together or Play Solo

Play alone or with friends as you explore, investigate, and piece together the evidence.

Split up to cover more ground, stay together to compare clues, or assign each player a different tool. Every round challenges you to observe the environment, communicate clearly, and make the right final guess.

Identify the Fairy

Every fairy type has its own clue combination and behaviour. Once you have gathered enough evidence, use your journal to narrow down the possibilities and decide which fairy you believe is present.

When you are ready, submit your answer and return through the portal.

Choose correctly, and your investigation is a success.

Features

  • Cosy fantasy investigation gameplay

  • Solo and online co-op multiplayer

  • Magical tools for discovering hidden evidence

  • Different fairy types to identify

  • Beautiful enchanted environments

  • Replayable investigations with different evidence combinations

  • Team-based deduction and exploration

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 2060 / AMD RX 580 / RX 6600 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
